text: Still here. Still with you. Which way now?
Another field, another fence. Follow me, I know this kind of place.
Go. Get up there without me.
From the armoury cart. I took two, here's one.
Here, catch. Don't pull the pin.
I know how this works. I have taken apart better ones.
Good. Now we go, before they come back.
Then I bring my spanner. I know where the fences are weak.
They wanted me to fly their glider over the line. I wouldn't. So they locked me in with the timetables.
Hello! In the yardmaster's hut! I am not with them!
Over here, by the tracks! Please!
Hey! The hut by the station! I can get you across the field!
